description: Find all stays that have specific amenities. Searches both stay-level amenities (referenced by tbStayFacilities) and room-level amenities (referenced by tbRoomFacilities). Use matchType 'any' to find stays with at least one amenity, or 'all' to find stays with all requested amenities. Can optionally filter by minimum WiFi download speed.

amenities.description: Array of amenity names to search for (e.g., ['WiFi', 'Air Conditioning', 'Pool']). Use getAllAmenities to see all available amenities.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 25)

matchType.description: OPTIONAL: 'any' (default) finds stays with at least one amenity, 'all' finds stays with all amenities

minWifiSpeed.description: OPTIONAL: Minimum WiFi download speed in Mbps (default: 0). Only returns stays with WiFi speed at or above this threshold.

name: getStaysByAmenities
